nb30de919e9.why: The National Bank of Poland is the country's central bank, and institutional disputes can affect investor confidence in Polish assets. The Constitutional Tribunal rules on the legality of laws.

na36af5e3a4.headline: ‘A lot more’: Rising rents pushing out young Perth couples
na36af5e3a4.summary: Young couples in Perth are struggling to find rentals comparable to the $700 they previously paid. The report describes rising rents pushing residents out.
na36af5e3a4.why: Rent levels reflect housing supply, demand and interest rate conditions, and they influence consumer spending and household budgets. Housing costs are a major factor in Australian economic policy debates.
